cases.knownDifference: Desktop treats an unknown format string as a custom pattern, so FORMAT(TRUE(), "General") is "Ge0eral" (the letter n is the minute token of a date pattern; the value is read as serial 0). BIForge returns "True". Not reproduced: the quirk is an accident of the pattern parser, not documented behavior.
